capabilities: Generate flashcards and multiple-choice, true/false, and open-ended questions from selected notes
Run focused study sessions with immediate feedback and targeted weak-topic practice
Run timed exam simulations with objective scoring and optional AI evaluation of open answers
Prioritize mistakes and unseen questions with Smart Review
Track study statistics, history, and completed exam results in a local dashboard
extras: Closed-source and proprietary: the public repository contains only release assets and docs, with source kept private. Free only during the Beta, which can end with notice; no automatic subscription is created. It has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and it explicitly lacks spaced repetition, local models, cloud sync, and telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert note content into graded study sessions, quizzes, or exam practice with links back to the source text.
